source_decision_draft.question: Six of the 22 Georgia Tech 2021 participants are missing here. Their checksummed publisher archives (2021) lack the static-pose trials and static-relative joint angles that our converter reads; the authors' 2024 copy, which the other 16 came from, has them but no publisher checksums. Where should the six come from?

options.label: Stop at 16 participants
options.consequence: The six are documented as unavailable; GT21 is released with 16 of 22; no downloads. Reversible.

options.label: Publisher version 1 archives (checksummed)
options.consequence: Bytes verified against publisher checksums; the six need a second recipe (model-zero angles, segment lengths from walking markers) or are released without joint angles; about 5.4 GB more to download. Reversible.

options.label: Authors' 2024 copy
options.consequence: Same folders and recipe as the 16; LocoHub records its own hashes at download; trial files can be checked against version 1 checksums if the planned one-participant comparison shows them unchanged; whether the copy holds all six is not yet checked. Reversible.

source_decision_draft.options_order: By participants releasable with the current converter (16, 16, up to 22); ties broken by download size (none, then about 5.4 GB).
source_decision_draft.why: The 16 local participants already come from the authors' 2024 update without publisher checksums, so C adds no new trust assumption and keeps one recipe and one angle reference across the cohort. B would mix two angle references in one dataset. C still depends on the copy holding all six, which is not yet checked.
source_decision_draft.check: Sheet, second figure: the version 1 column is red in the ik_offset and static rows, and the 2024 column is green there.
source_decision_draft.cost_of_waiting: The six stay unrecovered. Work on the 16, the AB17 checks and the one-participant comparison can continue; only recovery of the six waits.

plan.question: Did the 2024 author update change the shared trial files (conditions, emg, fp, gcLeft, gcRight, gon, id, ik, imu, jp, markers, osimxml) relative to publisher version 1?
plan.why: Settles, for any choice in D-GT21-S01-1, whether version 1 checksums can verify trial files of the 2024 copy and whether the 2024 RUN_OSIM update changed ik/id.
plan.subject: AB14
plan.selection_rule: Smallest version 1 archive of a participant already held locally.
